subject: [RFC PATCH 47/57] mm/madvise: collapse under a per-VMA read lock

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the MADV_COLLAPSE functionality in the Linux kernel to use a per-VMA read lock instead of acquiring and releasing the mmap_lock. This change allows multiple writers to access the address space simultaneously, reducing contention and improving performance. The patch also introduces new error handling for cases where the VMA cannot be locked or is being written to. Remote madvise operations are exempt from this change due to their unique requirements.
